messages.subject: poppr version 2.2.0 is released
parts:
Poppr version 2.2.0 has been released on CRAN. The binary files for Windows and OSX will be built within the next couple of days.

The biggest changes in this version are removal of previously deprecated functions (the *hierarchy functions), a significant bug fix for calculating the index of association for SNP data, and the re-export of the pipe operator from magrittr, which allows for chaining of commands.

Details for this version are here: https://github.com/grunwaldlab/poppr/releases/tag/v.2.2.0

Cheers,
Zhian
